A qualifying introduction requires the viewer's own perceived encounter, sufficient permitted text and a designated target meeting the threshold. An observer-private visual acquisition is eligible only for its sole recipient/observer; it is not a grant to narrate private thoughts, other observers' evidence or an unseen target to a witness. Stable `encounter:<entity-id>` milestones deduplicate privately across policy/version replacement, reentry, reconnect and restart. Other consequential events require explicit rules over supported committed types, roles and structured facts; an ordinary entity may qualify through such a rule. Routine activity involving a designated entity remains silent. Neither names nor arbitrary prose imply a consequential mechanic.

A further 90% whole-game reduction requires end-to-end attribution (PF00), not repeated optimization of an already sub-millisecond inner query. Existing native participant, independent-copy and experience-membership improvements remain; genuine first-acquisition work, external-event fan-out, snapshots and synchronous finalization remain distinct costs. Detailed deferred cases live in SW19/PF and maintainer TODO, not a competing performance list here.

## Navigation failure and shutdown

Navigation workers are derived computation, not persistence authority. Normal exit while active, asynchronous worker errors and synchronous launch/message-clone failures use the same bounded failure path. Failed result publication pauses on the existing storage-error boundary rather than repeatedly recomputing an uncommittable result. No new work starts while storage is faulted. Shutdown drains in-flight result publication and already-started termination before closing the store; replaced worlds fence results by existing map/timeline/action identity. Worker failure and stale retirement remain distinct metrics. A queue waiting on required data never becomes a false no-route answer.
Dense arrivals are a distinct workload. Initial visual acquisitions now have one observer-private recipient, eliminating the incorrect external witness multiplier; this is an evidence-scope correction, not dropped legitimate perception. Every real observer/source acquisition still requires storage. External speech/actions still use event-time audiences, and genuine all-to-all interactions can remain quadratic. Track events, recipient writes, history lookup and source-admission scans separately. EPR owns exposure deltas and hysteresis; PF owns commit/finalization costs. A synthetic scene's improvement does not authorize weaker perception, arbitrary event dropping or a higher supported population.
Current camera-facing sprite, privacy and combined-load evidence: [Mixed spatial review](verification/mixed-spatial-review.md). Earlier results below describe their own revisions.

Native visual acquisition now records observer-private evidence through EPR03; an observer noticing something is not an external act broadcasting it to neighbors. This shader still cannot sanitize any other upstream disclosure error. It also does not implement server viewport leases, distant camera knowledge or multiple controlled views (D51).
Ordinary 2D sprites face the camera in both yaw and pitch. Orbit/pitch must not expose an edge, select a different artwork view or foreshorten the image; ordinary perspective size, movement animation and lighting still apply. A screen-aligned card preserves its ground anchor and image proportions while an upright virtual body supplies depth and lighting coordinates. Picking uses the same virtual-body mapping. Physical collision, bodily heading and world-anchored shadow proxies do not rotate with the picture. This is a stylized depth approximation, not reconstructed hidden geometry; close perspective intersections need their own visual qualification. Opaque/cutout/dither depth and blended effects are separate material choices. Correct ordinary crate/character ordering must not depend on turning on read-through. Ghost art is remembered presentation only and never grants live picking, lights or animation facts.
A disconnected deck naturally intercepts part of a shadow and leaves other parts below; real geometric discontinuity is not a bug to erase by interpolating through empty space. Geometry-aware positioning and receiver geometry must nevertheless agree. Floor cutaways retain shadow casting, collision and acoustic effects; hiding the camera-facing roof must not open physical sunlight or sound through it. Generated shadow proxies must remain simple, reusable and stable under camera rotation. They register only as shadow casters, never as invisible color draws; hierarchy changes cannot reinsert them into the color pass. The shared 8-by-12-band proxy mesh has 192 triangles instead of a default 512-triangle sphere. Its explicit owner reference survives removing the last instance during a world reset and is released on disposal. Decorative plank seams share one non-casting mesh per surface instead of one box per seam. These approximations change presentation cost, not physical geometry or sensing.
